name: 4layer-impedance
description: Rigid FR4, four copper layers with controlled impedance. The pipeline builds the stackup, checks impedance and length matching, routes, runs DRC/DFM, and requires qualified stackup/impedance sign-off before a professional claim.
notes: The stackup must come from a real fabricator and be marked confirmed before sign-off.
Freerouting does not guarantee impedance; the pipeline computes geometry from the stated stackup and gates on the result.
Length matching is reported per netclass; verify the target against the interface timing budget.
